mcp.intro: Use Polyglot as a remote MCP server in Claude Desktop or Cursor. Auth is your login token in the URL (`?token=...`) — no Authorization header and no OAuth Client ID/Secret.
mcp.signIn: Sign in to copy your connector URL or config.
mcp.connector1: Open Claude Desktop → Settings → Customize → Connectors.
mcp.connector3: Name: enter PolyglotIO (or any label you like).
mcp.connector4: Remote MCP server URL: paste the URL below (token is already in the query string).
mcp.connector5: Leave Advanced settings / OAuth Client ID & Secret empty — Polyglot does not use OAuth.
mcp.connector6: Click Add. Claude will connect to your Polyglot account via that URL.
mcp.urlHelp: Paste into the URL field in Add custom connector. If you log out or get a new token, update the connector URL.
mcp.developer1: Open Claude Desktop → Settings → Desktop app → Developer.
mcp.developer2: Click Edit Config to open claude_desktop_config.json.
mcp.developer3: Merge the JSON below into mcpServers (keep any existing servers).
mcp.developer4: Save the file and fully quit + reopen Claude Desktop.
mcp.configHelp: Merge under mcpServers. Token is embedded in the URL — no headers or OAuth fields.
mcp.cursor1: Open Cursor → Settings → Cursor Settings → MCP (or Features → MCP).
mcp.cursor2: Click Add new MCP server / Edit in mcp.json.
mcp.cursor3: Merge the JSON below into mcpServers (keep any existing servers).
mcp.cursor4: Save. Cursor should pick up the Polyglot server; reload MCP if needed.
mcp.cursorHelp: Merge under mcpServers. Token is embedded in the URL — no headers needed.
